Inherent viscosities were measured using an Ubbelohde viscometer at a concentration of 0.5 g/dl in NMP at $3 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C}$.

Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) were recorded duplicate on a Stanton Redcraft STA-780 (London, UK) in air at a heating rate of 108C/min. In DSC thermograms, the samples were heated from 30 to $2 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } ,$they were cooled, and then re-heated to eliminate the thermal history.

The dynamic mechanical measurements were recorded on a Polymer Laboratories dynamic mechanical thermal analyzer over a temperature range of $2 5 { - } 3 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$at 1 Hz and a heating rate of 58C/min (Surrey, UK).
Infrared measurements were performed on a Bruker-IFS 48 Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectrometer (Ettlingen, Germany).
The H-nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra were recorded in DMSO-D solution using a Bruker Avance DPX 250 MHz (GmbH, Germany).

Wide-angle X-ray diffraction (WAXD) patterns were performed at room temperature on an X-ray diffractometer (Siemens model D 5000) using a Ni-filtered Cu Ka radiation (40 kV, 25 mA) at a scanning rate of 38/min.
UV spectra were obtained by a Cecil CE 1021 UV–Vis spectrometer (Cambridge, UK).
